title: Save class models and evaluation metrics
description: You inspect the arrays and metrics written into separate artifact files.

steps.description: You import file and JSON tools and create the artifacts directory if needed.
You save each class model into a named NPZ archive. Each archive contains its initial probabilities, transitions, emission parameters, and likelihood history.

steps.question: Which values enter the metrics JSON rather than the model archives?
steps.answer: The metrics dictionary contains accuracy converted to float and the confusion matrix converted to a list.

steps.description: You write metrics.json and list the artifact directory. The recorded listing includes the class archives and metrics file.
